cards.name: Aqua Fusion

effects.printed_clause: (This card is always treated as an "Aquamarine" card.)
effects.lua_implementation: Source archetype/set metadata provides 0xf3c identity and listed_series records it.

official_references.official_effect_text:
(This card is always treated as an "Elemental HERO" [b]and[/b] "Favorite" card.)
[b]Cannot[/b] be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by banishing 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster or 1 "Winged Kuriboh" from your hand, face-up field, or GY. [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Winged Kuriboh LV6" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. [b]When[/b] an opponent's monster declares an attack, or your opponent activates a monster effect on the field ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] Tribute this card; [b]destroy[/b] that 1 monster, [b]and if you do[/b], inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK.

effects.printed_clause: Fusion Summon 1 "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using 2 monsters from your hand, Deck, or field as Fusion Material.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation merges eligible hand/field and Deck materials, and s.exactlytwo is installed through aux.FCheckAdditional for every CheckFusionMaterial and SelectFusionMaterial call.

official_references.official_effect_text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster that mentions "Fallen of Albaz" as material from your Extra Deck, using 2 monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. You [b]cannot[/b] Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters, the turn you activate this card. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Branded Fusion" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.issue: Fixed: both ordinary and Chain Material paths now require exactly two selected Fusion Materials.

effects.printed_clause: You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck, except WATER Fusion Monsters, the turn you use this effect.
effects.lua_implementation: A custom activity counter checks the full turn and an oath restriction blocks non-WATER/non-Fusion Extra Deck Summons through PHASE_END.

official_references.official_effect_text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster that mentions "Fallen of Albaz" as material from your Extra Deck, using 2 monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. You [b]cannot[/b] Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters, the turn you activate this card. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Branded Fusion" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling Fusion Materials listed on it its materials into the Deck, from among your cards on the field, in your GY, and/or your face-up banished cards.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY Ignition Effect checks GetTurnID, banishes itself as cost, builds the stated face-up/available pool under Necrovalley, selects Fusion material, returns it to Deck and completes a Fusion Summon.

official_references.official_effect_text:
2 Cyberse monsters
[b]You can[/b] Tribute this card; [b]return[/b] 1 Fusion Monster from your GY to the Extra Deck, [b]then[/b] Fusion Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your GY. If this card is banished from your GY: [b]You can[/b] make Special Summoned monsters your opponent currently controls lose 400 ATK for each Cyberse monster currently in your GY, until the end of this turn.

official_references.matched_structure: return GY cards to shuffled Deck
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, [b]then[/b] draw 2 cards.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of "Aqua Fusion" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation and GY Fusion use distinct id/id+100 hard limits.

official_references.official_effect_text: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
